parts.label: Outer ear
parts.note: Collects sound and funnels it into the ear

parts.label: Eardrum
parts.note: A thin skin that shakes when sound hits it

parts.label: Ossicles
parts.note: Three tiny bones: hammer, anvil and stirrup

parts.label: Cochlea
parts.note: Snail-shaped: turns shakes into nerve signals

parts.label: Semicircular canals
parts.note: Fluid loops that sense balance and turning

parts.label: Auditory nerve
parts.note: Carries the signals to the brain

parts.label: Eustachian tube
parts.note: Links the middle ear to the throat
